messages:
Maria G: Quick sync — we need to lock go/no-go for the joint observability release with our HW partner + SI. Target announcement: Wed May 8. Proposed embargo ends Tue 5pm PT. Below are gating items. Who's OK with timeline?

Maria G: Checklist (WIP):
```
- sample app + OTEL instrumentation
- Datadog tile PR: redwood-dd/tile#58
- exporter docs + config snippets
- SI workshop slides + runbook
- demo recording (1-2 min) + teaser gif
- comms blurb + press approvals
- legal & partner NDAs cleared
- staging smoke tests ✅
```

Ana P: I can own exporter docs + config snippets. ETA Mon EOD. :white_check_mark:

Kevin L: We'll need a staging GPU queue for demo. I'll reserve a slot Tue 10am-12pm PT. @Devon (SI) can you confirm SI folks can join the run-through Tue 11am?

Devon (SI): Yup we can do Tue 11am. We'll bring two SIs for QA. Also need the runbook in Google Slides earlier — ping me when uploaded.

Lucy S: Comms side — draft blurb ready, waiting on final feature bullets and partner quote. Can someone drop the feature bullets here so I can finish.

Maria G: Feature bullets: (1) one-click telemetry tile for traces, metrics, logs; (2) prebuilt dashboards for HW utilization; (3) SI-managed onboarding with 1-day workshop.

press-bot: FYI — embargo window noted. Please fill out the press form: https://redwood.internal/press-form

Kevin L: Staging smoke command: `./scripts/run-smoke.sh staging --bundle=telemetry` — use that before demo. I'll run it Tue 9:30 PT and post results.

deploy-bot: deploy to staging completed at 1739912360 by ci/cd — artifacts: telemetry-bundle:v2

Ana P: Dropped docs draft here: https://docs.redwood/integrations/telemetry/exporter-draft — feedback welcome.

Lucy S: Thx Ana, looks good. I'll add the partner quote placeholder and ping legal for signoff.

Maria G: Ok plan: Tue 9:30 smoke, 10:00 staging demo, 11:00 SI join run-through. Comms to send embargoed note Tue 6pm PT if all green. Please react :thumbsup: if you agree or raise blockers now.

Kevin L: :thumbsup:

Devon (SI): :thumbsup:

Ana P: :thumbsup:

Lucy S: :thumbsup:
